large-retry.startup: Normal launcher retry succeeded without persistent settings changes after preceding HmdNotFound failure.

smoke.warning: Isolated smoke backend logged a background job.json.tmp reconciliation race for existing job 40c61cfafce5. Its job metadata still parses and status is running. Existing backend/worker PIDs remained alive; no job or worker was restarted.

final_native.coverage: indexed sphere and small bond groups, exact CPU geometry bytes, eligibility/budget fallback, persistent transform buffers, color/depth/ID parity and shadow transitions

limitations: Final Smooth windows include isolated 435.77 ms and 201.08 ms scene gaps with 360.5/147.4 ms upload maxima; p95 scene gaps remain about 33.6 ms and native/GPU frames stay stable. These remaining publication stalls prevent a seamless claim.

Final cis-syn-I raw ballstick window includes one 1005.35 ms submitted-scene gap: browser upload 928.90 ms, backend handler starts about 914 ms after upload_start and completes write in 11.77 ms; GPU max 2.54 ms, native frame max 12.75 ms. The upstream/queue delay is unresolved and is not attributed to GPU.

Initial CPD and large runs rebuilt between jobs while native implementation evolved; per-capture compact batch counts identify the active path. Final CPD and P1 repeats use the completed implementation.
Four-frame resident 24HB windows loop frequently; the deliberate non-interpolated loop hold is included in scene-gap maxima.
Offline GPU measurements exclude OpenXR, menus, mirror and canonical shadow pass, and use synthetic shadow depth.
Submitted application stereo is not physical through-lens comfort verification.
Browser publication acknowledgement is not native presentation acknowledgement.

excluded_attempts.reason: Optional final P1 app repeat failed startup before the native viewer launched: /api/vr/launch 503, status wait timed out. SteamVR compositor reported VRInitError_Init_HmdNotFound at 16:54:02 local. USB inventory still lists Vive devices. No playback samples from this attempt; private workspace removed and source fingerprints unchanged.
First ballstick export and version-matched stereo valid; later app workflow failed after frontend edits caused Vite HMR. Full run excluded; first exported scene used only for offline GPU tests.
Two tests retained old timing/debounce expectations; corrected explicit Smooth-off raw-throughput setup and initial publication debounce; focused2 passed.
